text:
alice: Quick heads-up — planning a schema cutover for user_profiles tomorrow 03:30 UTC. Goal: add signup_stage (small ENUM-ish varchar), pin service version for the window, run async backfill. Estimated exclusive lock time: ~5s for ADD COLUMN. Async backfill expected ~6h at conservative rate.

deploybot: scheduled migration request created by @alice for 2026-03-22T03:30:00Z. Canary plan: 10% traffic for 15m -> 50% for 10m -> 100%. Release note draft uploaded. :robot_face:

maria: :eyes: That overlaps with coredb maintenance (03:00-04:00). Can we nudge to 04:30?

alice: Prefer earlier to reduce user-facing latency nightly peak. What's the risk if coredb runs minor compaction at 03:15?

db-eng: Compaction + short DDL is risky. Option A: keep 03:30 and request coredb to shift. Option B: split into two-phase: (1) add nullable column + deploy code that writes new field, (2) backfill after peak (04:30). That avoids longer locks.

kevin: Two-phase sounds safest. We can do column add at 03:30 (no backfill), pin services to v2.14.0 with feature flag off. At 04:30 start backfill window and flip flag to read new column for a small percentage.

product-lead: Product prefers minimal user-visible changes. Two-phase + feature flag roll is fine.

db-eng: Draft migration SQL: ```sql
ALTER TABLE user_profiles ADD COLUMN signup_stage varchar(16);
-- nullable, no default to avoid table rewrite
```

db-eng: Backfill job details: run in batches of 10k rows / second, concurrency 6 workers, stop if avg p99 write latency > 250ms for 2m. Backfill will be resumable by last_processed_id.

sre-oncall: Add a quiesce/hangpoint at canary -> full rollout transition. If errors or lock spikes, we hit escape hatch: `/deploy hold user-profiles-cutover` and rollback traffic to pre-cutover version.

deploybot: canary job: `deploy --app=user-profiles --image=service:v2.14.0 --traffic=10% --hold-15m`

alice: Rollback plan (short): 1) Pause backfill workers. 2) Revert traffic pin to previous image. 3) If data already written to signup_stage and we must undo, feature flag controls reads so we can stop using the column immediately. Long-term revert (drop column) requires separate migration and won't run during emergency.

maria: Operational checklist for cutover: 
- preflight: ensure replication lag < 500ms and p99 write < 120ms (1h before)
- add column at 03:30 (expect ~5s lock)
- deploy v2.14.0 pinned with ff OFF
- verify canary for 15m, health checks green
- start backfill at 04:30 if metrics stable
- flip ff to gradual 10% read test -> 100%
- monitor: DB locks, p99 latencies, errorrate, SLOs

sre-oncall: I'll be on call during the window. Pager rules: escalate to oncall-sre->eng-leads if we see >2m sustained p95 error increase.

db-eng: Backfill kill command: `kubectl batch delete job backfill-signup-stage --namespace=prod` and `pkill -f backfill_worker` on the JVM pool — we'll add runbook steps in case pods misbehave.

kevin: Add a deferred safety: if backfill reaches 75% and p99 write >300ms, automatically pause and notify #eng-oncall with snapshot logs. We'll implement a controller that watches metrics.

deploybot: holdpoint created: `cutover_holdpoint_canary` (use `/deploy resume cutover_holdpoint_canary` to continue).

alice: Testing notes: engineering will run the migration in staging tonight using a copy of prod-ish data. We'll share results in this thread by EOD.

product-lead: Update release notes: "Adds lightweight signup_stage column to user_profiles. Rollout gated; no immediate user change."

maria: ack. please ping me when staging run completes. :thumbsup:

db-eng: Staging run completed: add column 3s lock, backfill 2h at same config. No errors, p99 spikes within expected. Logs uploaded to /mnt/shared/cutover-staging-logs.tar.gz

alice: Thanks. Final plan: two-phase -> add column @03:30 tomorrow, deploy pinned v2.14.0 with ff off, start backfill @04:30 if metrics ok, feature flag rollout after backfill readiness checks. Holdpoints set.

sre-oncall: I'll join the runbook channel during the window. If we need emergency rollback, call out in this thread and hit `/deploy hold`.

kevin: I'll own the backfill controller and emergency pause.

deploybot: migration executed in staging successfully. Production schedule remains 2026-03-22T03:30:00Z.

alice: Closing planning — will post final postmortem template link after window. Good luck everyone. :rocket:
